title: Adjunction conjugate completing a left refinement
statement: Given a prime l, algebraic closure Omega and two exact coefficient operations A and B on the same finite, integral, rational or closed stage, a shift-compatible natural isomorphism alpha from A.F to B.F determines a RefinementComparison. Its left map is alpha and its right map is conjugateIsoEquiv B.adjunction A.adjunction alpha. The counit and unit equations hold, and the right map commutes with shifts because the units, counits and alpha do. No geometric refinement hypothesis is required.

source.place: Adjunction conjugate completing a left refinement; normalized coefficient construction in the existing assembly node.

proof.text: Apply Mathlib conjugateIsoEquiv; its defining counit and unit equations give the two equations. Expand the right transformation as unit, whiskered alpha and counit; each factor commutes with integer shifts.
